source_check.definition_1_1: matches the formal model exactly: F1=1, F2=2, F(i+1)=F(i)+F(i-1); start = n copies of F1; moves A1, Cons(i) i>=2, Split(2), Split(i) i>=3.
source_check.priorities: Split Smallest = smallest split, else A1, else smallest combine; Combine Smallest = A1, else smallest combine, else smallest split. Confirmed against source section 1.2 and reviewer notes.
source_check.literal_defect: The MathDB record says the game 'starts from the Zeckendorf decomposition of n'. Under Definition 1.1 that position has NO legal move (all counts <=1 and no two consecutive indices occupied), so the game has zero moves. Formalized as Zeck.zeckendorf_start_has_no_move, Zeck.SS_zeckendorf_zero, Zeck.CS_zeckendorf_zero. This is a corpus transcription error, not a mathematical claim; it earns nothing.

axioms.observed: all audited theorems depend on exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorry, admit, axiom, unsafe or native_decide anywhere in src/.

steps_completed: 1. ZeckBase: literal game model, Fibonacci indexing F i = fib (i+1), value invariance, chip counts, the integer potential M with Wt 1 = 4, Wt 2 = 7, Wt i = i+5 (i>=3), per-move strict decrease, terminal positions, index bound.

2. ZeckStrategy: Split Smallest and Combine Smallest as deterministic step functions from Nat.find over the source priorities; termination proved by M; gameLen defined by Nat.find (no fuel bound); SS n and CS n are the real step counts from n copies of F 1.
3. ZeckControls: exact small values SS 2 = 1, SS 3 = 2, SS 4 = 3, CS 2 = 1, CS 3 = 2, CS 4 = 3 by proof; plus the Zeckendorf-start defect (zero moves) documented as a theorem.

4. ZeckPotential: the reviewer's exact potential w j = j + 2 + psi*(-psi)^j with psi = 1/phi; the four drop identities (A1 and both split types drop by exactly 1, Cons i drops by exactly i) proved as polynomial identities in phi, psi, s = -psi; Phi = sum a_j w_j with per-move exact drops; dropSS; the telescoped identity Phi(run k) = Phi(start) - sum_{j<k} dropSS.

4b. ZeckBound: w j > 0 for all j, hence Phi >= 0; every legal move drops Phi by at least 1; the exact identity SS n = phi^2 n - Phi(final) - sum_{j<SS n}(dropSS - 1); hence SS n <= phi^2 n (upper half of part (a)), plus the deficit form phi^2 n - SS n = Phi(final) + extra drops.
5. ZeckAudit: #print axioms for every main theorem.

theorems.SS_le_phi_sq: Zeck.SS_le_phi_sq : forall n : Nat, (SS n : Real) <= phi^2 * n
theorems.SS_eq: Zeck.SS_eq : forall n : Nat, (SS n : Real) = phi^2 * n - Phi (run stepSS (start n) (SS n)) - sum_{j in range (SS n)} ((dropSS (run stepSS (start n) j) : Real) - 1)
theorems.SS_deficit: Zeck.SS_deficit : forall n, phi^2 * n - (SS n : Real) = Phi (run stepSS (start n) (SS n)) + sum_{j in range (SS n)} ((dropSS (run stepSS (start n) j) : Real) - 1)
theorems.Phi_doA1: Zeck.Phi_doA1 : forall a, legalA1 a -> Phi (doA1 a) = Phi a - 1
theorems.Phi_doCons: Zeck.Phi_doCons : forall a i, legalCons a i -> Phi (doCons a i) = Phi a - (i : Real)
theorems.Phi_doSplit: Zeck.Phi_doSplit : forall a i, legalSplit a i -> Phi (doSplit a i) = Phi a - 1
theorems.Phi_stepSS: Zeck.Phi_stepSS : forall a, Phi (stepSS a) = Phi a - (dropSS a : Real)
theorems.zeckendorf_start_has_no_move: Zeck.zeckendorf_start_has_no_move : forall a, ZeckendorfPos a -> not (hasMove a)
theorems.SS_zeckendorf_zero: Zeck.SS_zeckendorf_zero : forall a, ZeckendorfPos a -> gameLen stepSS stepSS_drop a = 0
theorems.CS_zeckendorf_zero: Zeck.CS_zeckendorf_zero : forall a, ZeckendorfPos a -> gameLen stepCS stepCS_drop a = 0
theorems.exists_terminal: Zeck.exists_terminal : forall step, (forall a, hasMove a -> M (step a) + 1 <= M a) -> forall a, exists k, not (hasMove (run step a k))
theorems.gameLen_spec: Zeck.gameLen_spec : ... not (hasMove (run step a (gameLen step hstep a)))
theorems.gameLen_min: Zeck.gameLen_min : ... forall j < gameLen step hstep a, hasMove (run step a j)
